elements.name: Berth 3A
elements.about: A berth for one 2 km escort cruiser, which docks nose first towards Cruiser Gate 3, held by mooring arms along both sides.

elements.name: Berth control cabin
elements.about: The berth master watches the cruiser's mooring arms, power and hoses from here.

elements.name: Line handlers' shelter
elements.about: Shelter and kit for the crew who make the cruiser fast.

elements.name: Mooring arms
elements.about: Hydraulic arms that grip the cruiser's hull and hold it steady.

elements.name: Service apron
elements.about: The strip between the two berths, with shore connections, fuel valves and the gangway towers.

elements.name: Shore connection house
elements.about: Where shore power, water, air and data cables plug into the cruiser.

elements.name: Fuel valve house
elements.about: Valves that open the fuel line from the fuel farm to the cruiser.

elements.name: Gangway towers
elements.about: Towers with telescopic gangways that reach the cruisers' crew hatches.
